title: Light siteContext for an observed browser_click
description: When the daemon sets observe:true on a browser_click request and the extension advertises capability 'site-map', a successful click result carries this block. It runs no page script and reads no cookie or storage; anonymity is not probed. The daemon removes the block before the agent sees the result, as for 003's siteContext. Navigate and snapshot keep 003's full block (site-context.schema.json in 003).

url.description: Tab URL after the handler, userinfo removed; '' when unknown.

fromUrl.description: Tab URL captured before the handler (within URL_BEFORE_BUDGET_MS), userinfo removed; '' when unknown. The daemon attributes the click only when it matches its cached read.

topLevel.description: Tab-level URLs describe the top document.

stable.description: The handler-end URL equals a second read after it.
